history: A 1990s layered shot, and the base for several others.
whyItWorks: Butterscotch is sweet enough to need the cream’s fat to round it off; layering keeps them distinct until you drink.
steps: Pour the butterscotch schnapps into a shot glass.
Layer by pouring each ingredient slowly over the back of a bar spoon so it floats on the one below.
techniqueNotes: Pour the cream slowly enough that it sits rather than sinks.
name: Buttery Nipple
description: Butterscotch schnapps with Irish cream floated on top.
